summary: A save refreshes only the working tree and leaves decorations alone when there is nothing to paint. Whether git is usable, and the full status walk, wait until HEAD moves or the sidebar is open. The home screen and the dirty-file list stay quiet until there is a review to start or a session already running.

src/git/exec.ts.rationale: Caches the spawn env once; idle path is elsewhere

.tabthrough-guide.json.rationale: This sidecar, written into the tree it describes

res/skill/tabthrough/SKILL.md.rationale: Authoring register; same words as the other skill copies

work-docs/guides/agent-guide-authoring.m.rationale: Long-form of the same notes register

work-docs/architecture/guide-schema.md.rationale: One extra notes rule; idle path is elsewhere

src/model/setup.ts.rationale: Runtime echo of the skill's notes register

steps.title: Two clocks: tree and HEAD
steps.rationale: The split the rest of the idle path consults
steps.notes: A checkout records that HEAD must update before the 200ms wait. A save that lands during the wait still lets that checkout finish, so the sidebar shows the new branch. Tests write the clocks directly and skip the wait.

steps.title: Index and HEAD are separate watchers
steps.rationale: First consumer — fetch splits refs/** from logs/HEAD, so the first commit still arrives

steps.title: Capability follows HEAD
steps.rationale: Start enablement stays honest on init or checkout without a status walk on every save

steps.title: Home screen stays off git until a target
steps.rationale: Subscriptions sit after the early return, once a target exists
steps.notes: Until a review target exists, startPreview returns the idle constants. Git capability and status wait behind that return, so an idle editor leaves git cold.

steps.title: Dirty-file list stays cold when idle
steps.rationale: Same idle cut as capability — no session means no watch, and dirty files come from status first

steps.title: Status walk only while someone is looking
steps.rationale: Context keys and ownership were keeping a full status walk subscribed from activate
steps.notes: Command buttons and rebase-ownership read status only while the sidebar is visible or a review is open. Opening the sidebar is what starts the walk.

steps.title: Hidden sidebar uses the idle constants
steps.rationale: First consumer of the gate — gitState and startPreview stay cold on a hidden home screen

steps.title: Opening the sidebar starts the walk
steps.rationale: The writer for the visibility gate, plus the rewrite that used to run on every new object identity

steps.title: Decorations ignore foreign keystrokes
steps.rationale: setDecorations was on every document change even when ranges were empty

steps.title: Guide validation is debounced once
steps.rationale: Footnote — typing a sidecar parses once per burst

steps.title: Idle clocks are independent in tests
steps.rationale: Confirms the split above — capability ignores a worktree tick
